scope: For a rational two-dimensional plane in seven coordinates, prove the exact standard-product-plane classification at actual loneliness 1/7, conditional only on LonelyRunnerBound 5 and PrimitiveSixClassification. Prove the unconditional converse value of the standard product plane. Derive the original large-norm family conclusion for every positive primitive seven-speed tuple with loneliness below 1/7 and Euclidean norm at least 7*42^10: an actual permutation of [1,2,3,4,5,6,7*s], with s >= 1 and exact value s/(7*s+1). The geometric, finite, arithmetic, signed-permutation, integer-parameter and real-time-value bridges are proved internally. The two lower-dimensional mathematical hypotheses remain explicit; this gate does not prove an unconditional plane or spectrum classification.
